done_when: At close, an item that may not change settings and carries a forge.toml different from main's gets main's copy back (its version pin line kept), committed with one printed line; the worker's settings restore takes main's side of an open merge; tests cover a Codex round that merged main's changed settings, on new and adopted repos
why: After a Codex round merges main, the branch can still carry its older forge.toml, so the squash merge reverts main's settings (issue 921, Codex path)
